fusions.name: Lilypad Lash
fusions.desc: A lashing blow that deals 14 damage, up to 1.6 times that at maximum range, and stuns the target for 1 second.

fusions.name: Croak Spray
fusions.desc: Sprays a cone that deals 9 damage to everything in it. It costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Sudden Spring
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 6 seconds. You finish it 3 tiles from where you stood, with +10% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Lurking Springtoad
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded springtoad that fights beside you, striking for 4 damage. Anything it strikes moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.
